verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio explicitly supports exporting team configurations as JSON or Python code, which is a concrete open-format export capability, and since AutoGen runs locally/self-hosted there's no inherent vendor lock-in. However, there is no evidence of exporting broader user data (conversation logs, memory stores, run history) in open formats beyond team/agent configs. Missing for 10: documented full data export (conversations, memory, logs) in open formats, explicit statement on data portability/no lock-in beyond team configs.
